Ali Nu Yaad Karo Ral Ke Faryad Karo Hai Ghareebaan Da Ayho Aasra.
Ali Maula Ali Maula Ali Dam Dam Lakh Te Crore Wari Aakho Jam Jam.
Nabi Da Pyara Ali Noor Aala Noor.
Ali Da Aye ALLAH, ALLAH Kabay Che Zahoor.
Ali Maula Odhay Jidhay Maula Ne Hazoor.
Ali Peer Peeraan Da Aye Dil Da Saror.
Waliyaan De Siraan Da Aye Taj Ali Ali.
Momina Di Bas Aye Mairaj Ali Ali.

Ghama De Tofana Che Kinara Ali Ali.

Bari Shan Aye Nabi De Baad Ali Di.
Paye Mangday Ne Sab Imdad Ali Di.
 Bari Main Ki Dasaan Rodad Ali Di.
Ibadat Ain Ibadat Yaad Ali Di.
Nabi De Noor Di Tanveer Haider.
Kitab-e-Ishq Di Tafseer Haider.
Ali De Zoor Taun Sadqay Main Saim.
Hai Dinda Kafiraan Nu Cheear Haider.
Shujat Da Aye Paikar Kaun Haider.
Fateh Karda Aye Khaybar Kaun Haider.
Hai Marhab Cheriya Kis Ne Ali Ne.
Te Aye Saim Hai Safdar Kaun Haider.
Ali Di Pachan Hai Rab Di Pachan.
Ali Diyaan Taqtaan Nu Janrda Jahan.
Rab Da Aye Shair Ali, Ali Di Aye Shan.
Kul De Imam Ali Nabi Da Aye Ayelan.
Haider-e-Karrar Buturab Ali Ali.
Hashmi Jarrar La Jawab Ali Ali.
Jaina Da Na Koi Ali Ona Da Bharam.

Har Welay Te Har Pasay Mere Naal Ali Aye.
Mera Mazi Ali Aye Mera Haal Ali Aye.
Karan Sham Saweray Faryad Ali Nu.

Lajpal Ali Aye Lajpal Ali Aye.
Ali Waris Muhammad De Chaman Da.
Ali Tara Nabi Di Anjuman Da.
Ali Oh Gul Hai Saim Jis Di Hoya.

Aye Dasta Mukamal Panjtan Da.
Main Mangta Haan Keyda Maula Ali Da.
Main Sheda Haan Keyda Maula Ali Da.
Hai Saim Te Nazar Kis Di Ali Di.

Main Banda Haan Keyda Maula Ali Da.
Mera Pyar Ali Aye Meri Jan Ali Aye.
Meri Aas Ali Aye Mera Maan Ali Aye.
 Bari Barda Ali Da Te Sultan Ali Aye.

Akhiyaan Di Thand Ali Dilaan Da Qarrar.

Sadqay Ali De Sari Khili Aye Bahar.
Kariye Na Kyun Assi Fair Ali Ali.
Sukh Le Ke Aandi Aye Sawair Ali Ali.
Ali Ali Aakhiye Te Nas Janday Gham.

Ali Saday Dil Wich Ali Saday Sanwaan Wich.
Ali Saday Aasay Pasay Ali Aye Nigawaan Wich.
Ashiqaan De Dheray Bari Ali Diyaan Rawaan Wich.
Rakhay Rab Sariyaan Nu Ali Di Panawaan Wich.

Ali Dehar-e-Muhabbat Da Shanawar.
Ali Mushkil Kusha Mehboob-e-Dawar.
Ali Firdos Da Malik Hai Saim.
Ali Nu Bakhshiya Khaliq Ne Kausar.

Ajab Shan-e-Sakhawat Hai Ali Di.
Haram Andar Wiladat Hai Ali Di.
Ali Wal Wekhna Saim Ibadat.
Keh Masjid Wich Shahadat Hai Ali Di.

Ajab Husan-e-Mualla Hai Ali Da.
Ajab Noor-e-Tajalla Hai Ali Da.
Main Saim Ais Layi Haider Taun Mangda.
Ali ALLAH Da ALLAH Hai Ali Da.

ALLAH Nabi Janrda Aye Ali Da Maqam.

Qatilaan Nu Ali Denday Sharbataan De Jaam.
Putraan Da Ali De Faqeraan Nu Inam.
Shehanshayiyaan Rakhday Ne Ali De Ghulam.
Totay Hoye Dilaan Di Aawaz Ali Ali.

Ashiqaan Da Wird Te Namaz Ali Ali.
Ali Jiya Shair Kehra Rab Di Qasam.
Faqeraan Da Sahara Kaun Haider.
Imamat Da Sitara Kaun Haider.

Hai Dasiya Rishta Aye Zahra Ne Saim.
Muhammad Da Pyara Kaun Haider.
Jahan Te Raaj Kis Da Hai Ali Da.
Faqeeri Taj Kis Da Hai Ali Da.

Imamat Kis Di Hai Saim Ali Di.
Jag Muhtaj Kis Da Hai Ali Da.
Mustafa Da Veer Ali Mustafa Da Veer.
Qutbaan Te Ghausaan Da Aye Ali Dastgeer.

Hath Wich Kausar Maula Ali Di Tauqeer.
Sadi Deen Ali Bajoon Deen Di Jageer.
Ditha Nahin Koi Dosra Shah Zoor Ali Ali.
Dunya Te Honra Nahin Koi Hor Ali Ali.

Kul Da Zamane Uttay Ali Da Alam.
Ali Dobi Hoi Qismat Taraway.
Raway Pokhaan Te Mangtay Nu Khilaway.
Aye Mumkin Hi Nahin Saim Kadi V.

Koi Khali Ali De Dar Tu Jaway.
Chehra Maula Ali Da Aye Rab Di Kitab.
Nabi Farmaya Maula Ali Buturab.
Nabi Shehar Ilmaan Da Maula Ali Baab.

Ali Ali Aakhna Sawab Be Hisab.
Haidery Malangaan Di Aye Yaad Ali Ali.
Mangday Ne Sare Imdad Ali Ali.
Ali Diyaan Shana Bari Likhe Ki Qalam.

Reconstructed all 104 verses of [Ali Nu Yaad Karo](src/data/lyrics/ali-nu-yaad-karo.md) in Shahmukhi Punjabi. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` and checked that verse counts and block breaks match.

Updated the language metadata to reflect the Punjabi grammar and removed the missing-source tag. The Roman readings “Bari” and “Barda” are ambiguous and were rendered as `بڑی` and `بردہ`.
